notes: 530 occupied social dwellings transformed; 44,210 m2 existing plus 23,500 m2 extensions. The project retained the existing structure, stairs and floors and added winter gardens/balconies. Do not transfer extension/existing ratio to national PAS.
640 t and 11 material batches are project-scale reuse evidence across a mixed retained/new-build redevelopment. Never divide by dwellings or floor area to create a national renovation intensity.

360 radiators were inventoried; only 50 were reconditioned. Poor removal/storage and inappropriate cutting destroyed part of the reuse potential; qualified dismantling skills were reported as scarce. Use as a skills/logistics gate, not a national reuse rate.
